name: Michael Podemski
bio: Michael Podemski (born October 4, 2011) is a Canadian actor. He is known for It: Welcome to Derry (2025), Reservation Dogs (2021), and Anne with an E (2017). He has also appeared in the children’s television series Molly of Denali (2019) and the film Mouthpiece (2018).

credits.title: A Story of Derry
credits.overview: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

credits.title: Take Care
credits.overview: In the days following the death of her grandmother, Hope witnesses her mother and uncle clash over cultural protocols surrounding the burial, while processing her own grief.

credits.title: Mouthpiece
credits.overview: Based on a stage play of the same name by Amy Nostbakken and Norah Sadava, the story follows Cassandra, who is portrayed by the two women, expressing the opposing voices that exist inside the modern woman's head, during a 48-hour period as she tries to organize the affairs for her mother's funeral.
